Breakfast Heaven
Aug 2026 • Business
I have enjoyed breakfast buffets in 5 star hotels all over the world. They would all be hard-pressed to beat this restaurant’s layout!!!! First off, the coffee all on its own is a WIN! I have enjoyed this feast three or four times Maru was on duty, and I think I’ve hugged her good bye each time. That woman is the queen of top-tier service!!! I’ll be back with my husband in tow to make sure I’m a great judge of ambience and quality. I know he’ll rave too!!
